anomalies.title: Brain trade_history.csv missing entry_source, regime_at_entry, regime_at_exit, closed_at, mfe, mae, bars_held, time_in_trade for ALL 142 trades
anomalies.detail: These columns exist in the CSV header but are blank/zero for every row. This means the live_engine is not persisting these fields when recording trades to brain history. The data exists in-memory during tick processing but is not captured.
anomalies.impact: Cannot do post-hoc analysis of entry sources, regime context, or trade duration from historical data. Does not affect runtime correctness.
anomalies.recommended_action: Future improvement: wire entry_source, regime_at_entry, regime_at_exit, closed_at, mfe, mae into brain trade recording. Not a tonight fix.

anomalies.title: realized_trades DB table is empty (0 rows) despite 142 brain-tracked trades
anomalies.detail: The organism records trades in brain's trade_history.csv but does not write to the realized_trades DB table. This means the DB has no queryable trade history.
anomalies.impact: Cannot query trade history via SQL/API. Brain CSV is the only source of truth.
anomalies.recommended_action: Future improvement: wire organism trade close events into realized_trades table. Not a tonight fix.

anomalies.title: 'async for' error in POST /api/v1/orders/validate (5 occurrences at 07:20 UTC)
anomalies.detail: Unhandled exception: 'async for' requires an object with __aiter__ method, got list_iterator. Triggered by pre-market frontend order validation requests.
anomalies.impact: Only affects the manual order validation API endpoint, not the organism's trading loop. Pre-market only.
anomalies.recommended_action: Fix the async iteration bug in orders.py validate endpoint. Low priority.

anomalies.title: Alpha weights sum = 0.9497 (warning at startup)
anomalies.detail: Brain validation warns that alpha weights sum to 0.9497 instead of ~1.0. This is a cosmetic gap in evolved_params.json.
anomalies.impact: Negligible — the weights are used only in production mode (after ML training). In learning mode, alpha scoring uses fixed weights.
anomalies.recommended_action: Normalize alpha weights in evolved_params.json. Very low priority.

anomalies.title: 721-second tick gap at 13:55 UTC
anomalies.detail: 12-minute gap between ticks at 13:43:44 and 13:55:56 UTC. Likely caused by container resource contention or a long-running feature computation.
anomalies.impact: Missed ~55 ticks worth of scanning. Non-blocking, self-recovered.
anomalies.recommended_action: Monitor for recurrence. If frequent, investigate container resource limits.

anomalies.title: Post-close scheduler backoff loop (consecutive_errors=1)
anomalies.detail: After market close (~21:00 UTC), the scheduler enters a continuous backoff loop with 2s intervals. The error is likely a timeout on stale/unavailable market data.
anomalies.impact: Expected behavior. The scheduler will resume normal ticking when the market reopens.
anomalies.recommended_action: None — this is by design. The scheduler backs off on errors rather than crashing.
